ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde human trust & safety review of the dangerous-driving allegation; log the rider complaint, driver statement and trip record; advise rider of the RydeHELP report path and that 995 / commercial-insurance medical-claim channels apply if injured. Do not auto-adjudicate any fare item.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the rider's complaint alleges speeding, hard braking all the way and overtaking on the shoulder — a dangerous-driving allegation, and the dispute type is itself "safety". Under SAFE-2 this case is not automatically adjudicated; the ruling is escalate with a factual summary for a human reviewer [F6]. The same applies under SAFE-1 to the extent the record contains a hostile/unsafe-riding claim worth a human look; no threatening, harassing or sexual language appears in the chat, which is two message(s), all timestamped [F3][F4][F5].

The measurable record is otherwise benign: the actual route was 8.3 km against an 8.4 km optimal route (-0.1 km, -1%) [F1] and the trip took 12.7 min against an estimated 13.8 min [F2] — so no route-deviation (RD-1/RD-2) issue is opened, and the driver's statement that he drove normally is contradicted only by the rider's unmeasured driving-conduct allegation, which is not something a system record can resolve [F6]. No fare item is disputed (no cancellation fee, waiting fee or extra charge in the facts), so no NS/FARE clause applies; profiles are never decisive on their own and both parties show clean 90-day records with 0 upheld disputes [F7][F8], so RD-6 flagging is not triggered. Evidence status is sufficient for the safety-screening outcome, but the safety allegation itself is not resolvable from the record, so it goes to a human.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-2: the case involves a dangerous-driving allegation (speeding, hard braking, shoulder overtaking) and is filed as a safety dispute, so no automatic ruling is issued; factual summary forwarded to Ryde human review with 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting guidance.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement 'I drove normally; the rider never complained' conflicts with the rider's safety allegation; a statement is not a system record and cannot resolve an alleged driving-conduct safety issue — left to human review rather than used to dismiss the complaint.
Rider profile (long tenure, 4.6 rating, 0 prior disputes) cannot decide the case on its own and does not rebut the safety allegation.
Driver profile (4.85 rating, 963 trips, 0 upheld disputes) cannot decide the case on its own; it also does not trigger RD-6 flagging because it shows no prior upheld dispute.

safety_basis: Rider complaint alleges speeding, hard braking throughout and overtaking on the shoulder (dangerous driving)
Dispute type filed as safety; rider states she was scared and felt unsafe
ruling.evidence_gap: No telematics/vehicle data (speed, harsh-braking, lane position) in the record to test the dangerous-driving allegation; the riding-conduct claim rests on the rider's statement and is left to the human reviewer.
